usedFor: AskHandle holds support rooms: “Create a Room” opens one and “New Room” tells you when one appears.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack, then “Create a Room” in AskHandle
bestTemplate.why: A room opens in AskHandle when a message arrives, so support has somewhere to answer.

watchOut: “New Room” in AskHandle is polling, so new rooms are noticed on a schedule, not the moment they open.
